purpose: Evidence-precedent scan for the selector design's 'adaptivity must demonstrably help' requirement: GPR adaptive parameter selection vs fixed baselines, and general algorithm-selection usefulness conditions; retrieval does not imply reading or replication
notes: Fast scan, not a systematic review; two papers read in main text, four at abstract/snippet level, three citations registered without reading.
No dataset downloaded or imported; no training performed; no threshold or expected-benefit value adopted for this repo.
